executor: Parent-owned server-only reader after complete family closure and source/row identity admission.
purpose: Separate residual graph-evidence supply from availability already supplied by factorizedI4 and from deployed retention.
existing_evidence: COMPARISON already has factorM1/shared-to-I4 exact pairwise common-rival acquisition and served/lost counts. Reuse those counts. Existing server-only joint evidence binds all three seeds; do not download raw arrays or infer unobserved intersections.
required_identity: identical complete TRAIN/VALID node-row ids, labels, class convention and split digest
frozen selected checkpoints/member selection and declared reducer
all owners admitted before reading quality
exact graph operator/view provenance per bank; same-operator weight variants do not identify operator sensitivity

definitions.Q_s: VALID nodes where every shared-own4 member strictly ranks one identical false rival above truth (existing exact cohort).
definitions.A_F: At least one correct member in complete stronger factorizedI4.
definitions.A_G: At least one correct member in a complete admitted declared route/operator/view bank G.
definitions.S_F_or_S_G: Correctness of that bank's actual frozen deployed prediction.
definitions.E_s: Q_s intersect not A_F; residual common-rival nodes despite stronger I4 available predictions.
definitions.lost_unique_supply: E_s intersect A_G intersect not S_G.
definitions.already_supplied: Q_s intersect A_F intersect A_G, retaining the two serving correctness bits.
definitions.outside_harms: Nodes outside Q_s where baseline deployed prediction is correct and G deployed prediction is wrong; also report reverse repairs.

minimal_readout: one simultaneous contingency table per seed and class over Q, correct-member bitmasks for complete factorizedI4/genuineI4/G, and actual served correctness
unique supply retained/lost plus repairs/harms and per-member mean/worst own quality
cross-seed identity persistence only when row identities match; report exact intersections, never derive node identity from net counts
server-only node-cohort digest; no raw local prediction export
currently_possible: With existing admitted joint same-operator banks, this join can test unique residual availability of genuineI4 versus factorizedI4 and serving retention. It cannot attribute a gain to graph evidence changes.
availability_limit: Changed-operator/view predictions must actually be saved and fully closed. If absent, the key unique_supply statistic for changed graph evidence is unavailable. No fresh forwards, refits, synthetic proxy, grid or partial-family read is authorized by this note.
interpretation_rules: No unique_supply: that stored bank provides no evidence for resolving the residual supply problem on the exact cohort. This is bank-specific, not a proof against all graph operators.
Positive unique_supply with weak own quality or large outside harms: available alternatives alone do not support a useful mechanism.

Positive unique_supply with retained predictions and preserved competence: motivates a narrowly attributed mechanism test with matched operator/evidence and supervision controls; does not establish causality or novelty.
Only same-operator banks available: report the residual/retention observation and explicitly leave operator sensitivity and structural uncertainty unidentified.
